title: wizard
objective: Reserved for plan 06: premise → interview → staged proposals → provisioned ST assets → playable story, create-only and reviewed per operation.
reservedReason: defined by plan 06 (story wizard) — not runnable before it lands

checks.goal: the wizard interviews before proposing (in-protocol questions), and 'you decide' proceeds under stated defaults
provisioning proposals are create-only and rejected by op validation when they target an existing user character or a non-story lorebook
each provisioning op is applied by explicit per-op review and excluded from bulk accept
'Fix with wizard' from the requirements panel resolves a missing member or lorebook

checks.prompt: Starting from a one-line premise, did the wizard get you to a story you actually wanted to play?
checks.anchors: 1 = fought it · 3 = usable after edits · 5 = better than what I would have written
